name: @caotang/import-odt
description: The OpenDocument reader for the ODT import (#298): an own reader on the shared zip and XML layer — text:h outline levels, the style chain, lists and quotes, footnotes and endnotes inline, annotations as notes, tracked changes in accept/reject/keep, pictures from the package, tables as paragraphs, and a flat .fodt read without a zip. No DOM, no third-party dependency; runs on the main thread, in a 'self' Worker and in Node.
